Method of Attack: Arbitrary code execution via option injection in .gitmodules URL starting with a dash
Malicious repository creates .gitmodules file with URL starting with dash causing git clone subprocess to interpret URL as an option and execute arbitrary commands
Attack Vector: Cloning malicious repositories using git clone --recurse-submodules with crafted .gitmodules file
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious .gitmodules file with URL: ssh://-oProxyCommand=touch VULNERABLE/git@github.com:/timwr/test.git
